name: Cutting Down Trees
overview: Scripture teaches that trees hold significant practical and symbolic value, as seen in Deuteronomy 20:19 where trees are described as life to man and are protected even during warfare. Joshua 17:15 encourages the use of woodlands for provision when land is limited, emphasizing responsible stewardship. Isaiah 44:14 highlights the purposeful cutting and nurturing of trees for strength and utility. Conversely, Jeremiah 10:3 condemns the vain practice of fashioning idols from cut trees, warning against adopting heathen customs. Together, these passages underscore a God-centered respect for creation that balances usefulness with reverence.
